subject: Fraud & Scams
title: The Setup and the Sting
description: A quick, practical guide to The Setup and the Sting.

hook.text: The setup makes the victim feel lucky. The sting takes their money before they realize what happened.

buildup.text: Every con has a setup phase where the con artist creates a scenario that feels natural.

discovery.text: The sting is timed perfectly — the victim commits money or information at the moment of peak trust.

twist.text: After the sting, victims often don't realize they've been scammed for days, weeks, or even years.

climax.text: The best cons end with the victim thanking the con artist — and never suspecting a thing.

punchline.text: The perfect crime leaves the victim smiling.

quiz.question: When does the 'sting' happen in a con?
options: At the moment of peak trust
After the victim calls the police
